Figure 7.4: Use of Event Buffers and Context Data Buffers
Figure 7.4 shows how event buffers and context buffers are used when security events
are set via the IdsM API as this chapter explains. Upon reception of a SEv, the event
is stored in a buffer from the event buffer pool and its corresponding context data
is stored in a buffered of the most adequate size from the context data buffer pool.
These two buffers are linked and processed together asynchronously in the IdsM_
MainFunction service.
